stories.title: NBA 2K27 Video Review - IGN
stories.summary: NBA 2K27 reviewed by Nico Vergara on PC, also available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2."NBA 2K27 is a reflection of the budding prospect who couldn’t quite put things together. Sure, it made a splash at first, with a smooth on-court experience that’s better than in recent years, but it fails to follow that up with anything meaningful. A middling MyCareer story doesn’t help its case and flawed new modes, like MyCareer Eras and MyNBA Legacy, only worsen things by highlighting long-running problems. It’s a tale as old as time, a clichéd one that starts with “what if,” or “if only,” and right now, I’m ready to close the book before I even reach the final chapter."
